QUOTE: The argument compared is the first string-valued field of the call's JSON arguments (`args_to_pattern`). If there are no arguments, or parsing fails, it is `*`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: States that only one argument (first string-valued field) is used for matching and that no-args or parse failure becomes `*`. Rest of arguments being unused is implied. The non-string case is only partly covered, since it says "first string-valued field" without stating that a non-string value collapses to a wildcard. That is still enough for the substance.
